q1_issues.issue: (Ordinal sk_column_1 last column) puts the entity's own kind in the scale slot, which the instruction set defines as the associated event or an explicit "-est" dimension.

q2_gaps: An ordinal on a bare NP with no associated event and no "-est" dimension ("Lacy's LAST column") — the scale slot has no licensed filler.

A temporal possessive NP ("FRIDAY'S editions") — the 's genitive rule yields (Possession <group> friday) with a bare weekday constant, and nothing says whether the temporal content should also surface as a Time / (Weekday friday) term, so "when did it appear?" cannot bind.
notes: The reduced relative "filed from the hospital" is reified as an agentless past event with Theme/Source exactly as the participial-post-modifier rule requires, and sk_column_1 is correctly reused across all three clauses. The possessed plural "Friday's editions" correctly takes a group witness rather than Inheritance.
